title: The Avengers - S.H.I.E.L.D Helicarrier with download and schematic!
author: VISR3

generated.description: A large flying aircraft carrier inspired by S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Helicarrier from The Avengers, built mostly from stone, black and white wool, glass, and glowstone with a long hull, a raised bridge and multiple decks. It is very large at about 298 by 60 by 141 blocks, with an interior containing chests, furnaces, enchanting tables, and signs.
